name: MATRIX360 Lakhotia | n8n Cloud Draft Intake v0.5

nodes.name: Call Lakhotia Draft API
nodes.notes: Set your real HTTPS API host and select an n8n Header Auth credential with name X-Matrix360-Key and a private random token. Never paste secrets into workflow JSON.

parameters.jsCode: const base='https://YOUR-SECURE-MATRIX360-API-DOMAIN.example'; return $input.all().map((item,index)=>{const x=item.json; if(!x.id||x.status!=='review'||!Array.isArray(x.candidates)||x.candidates.length!==3) throw new Error('Malformed draft response');return {json:{draft_id:x.id,status:x.status,provider:x.provider,brief_index:index+1,review_url:base+'/draft/'+x.id,preview_urls:(x.preview_urls||[]).map(p=>base+p),compliance:x.compliance,approval_required:true,publication_enabled:false}};});

nodes.name: Create Review Queue Entries
nodes.notes: Review URL is illustrative; the existing local app uses /draft/{id} and it may require authentication behind a secure access proxy. Do not expose unauthenticated preview URLs.
